card.name: Words leading into 'storage' headings
card.fires_on: The word 'and' (or 'when') right before an expected 'storage' or 'stored', as in 'Stability and Storage' or 'Storage and Handling' headings and cross-references in drug labels.

modes.label: Storage heading links
modes.description: 'and' after Storage, Stability or How Supplied/Storage, where the next word is Handling, Stability or Storage.

modes.label: Stable when stored
modes.description: 'when' after a stability statement about unopened vials, just before 'stored'.
modes.example: Unopened vials of Bortezomib for Injection are stable until the date indicated on the package<< when>> stored in the original package protected from light

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'storage' or 'stored' next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before 'storage' or 'stored' in label headings and stability statements.
